<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <script>
/*
 * Premium ad-skip flag, written by icyveins-topbar-account.js from GET /v1/billing/status.
 *
 * icy-auth's `icy_session` cookie is httpOnly and host-only to the auth domain, so neither
 * this page nor the www server can see it -- premium status is only knowable after an
 * authenticated fetch. This flag caches the last answer so the ad and analytics loaders
 * below can decide at first paint. It is a paint optimisation, not a security boundary.
 *
 * The key is shared with the Astro app (src/lib/billing/premium-flag.ts); both are served
 * from the www origin, so a signed-in reader crossing between them keeps the flag.
 */
function icyIsPremium () {
  try {
    return window.localStorage.getItem('icy:premium') === '1'
  } catch (e) {
    return false
  }
}

function writeToLocalStorage(key, content) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, content);
  } catch(e) {
    for (var i = 0; i < window.localStorage.length; i++) {
      current_key = window.localStorage.key(i);
      if (current_key != 'premium_tracking' && current_key != 'premium_origin' && current_key != 'icy:premium') {
        window.localStorage.removeItem(current_key);
      }
    }
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, content);
  }
}
    </script>

    <script>
  // icyIsPremium() comes from the inline <script> at the top of templates/template.html, or
  // from BaseLayout.astro on the Astro frontend, which also sets ivAdFreeSurface on pages
  // such as /premium that never carry ads.
  //
  // The u.gg desktop app frames the site and serves its own ads. It marks only the first
  // URL it loads, with ?embed=uggapp; BaseLayout.astro carries that across in-frame
  // navigation in sessionStorage, which both frontends share on the www origin, so it is
  // read here for pages the SSG serves as well.
  function isEmbeddedInApp() {
    if (window.ivEmbedMode) return true;
    if (window.self === window.top) return false;
    if (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('embed') === 'uggapp') return true;
    try {
      return sessionStorage.getItem('ivEmbedMode') === 'uggapp';
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  window.shouldDisplayAds = function () {
    return !icyIsPremium() && !isEmbeddedInApp() && !window.ivAdFreeSurface;
  };

  window.runAdScript = function (callback) {
    if (window.shouldDisplayAds() && typeof callback === 'function') callback();
  };
</script>

<script data-cfasync="false" type="text/javascript">
  window.runAdScript(function () {
    // freestar.queue holds code for the engine to run, freestar.config every
    // configuration option, and freestar.config.enabled_slots each placement on the page.
    window.freestar ||= {};
    window.freestar.queue ||= [];
    window.freestar.config ||= {};
    window.freestar.config.enabled_slots = [];

    // The engine calls this once it loads. It hands over whatever placements have
    // registered so far, or asks to be called again when none have yet.
    window.freestar.initCallback = function () {
      if (window.freestar.config.enabled_slots.length === 0) {
        window.freestar.initCallbackCalled = false;
      } else {
        window.freestar.newAdSlots(window.freestar.config.enabled_slots);
      }
    };

    // Freestar ship the engine as a plain <script src>; injecting it from here is what
    // keeps it behind the premium gate.
    var engine = document.createElement('script');
    engine.src = 'https://a.pub.network/icy-veins-com/pubfig.min.js';
    engine.setAttribute('data-cfasync', 'false');
    engine.async = true;
    // currentScript is null when something else, such as Rocket Loader, runs this script.
    var anchor = document.currentScript;
    if (anchor) {
      anchor.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', engine);
    } else {
      document.head.appendChild(engine);
    }
  });
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>

  <head>
    <script>
/*
 * Premium ad-skip flag, written by icyveins-topbar-account.js from GET /v1/billing/status.
 *
 * icy-auth's `icy_session` cookie is httpOnly and host-only to the auth domain, so neither
 * this page nor the www server can see it -- premium status is only knowable after an
 * authenticated fetch. This flag caches the last answer so the ad and analytics loaders
 * below can decide at first paint. It is a paint optimisation, not a security boundary.
 *
 * The key is shared with the Astro app (src/lib/billing/premium-flag.ts); both are served
 * from the www origin, so a signed-in reader crossing between them keeps the flag.
 */
function icyIsPremium () {
  try {
    return window.localStorage.getItem('icy:premium') === '1'
  } catch (e) {
    return false
  }
}

function writeToLocalStorage(key, content) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, content);
  } catch(e) {
    for (var i = 0; i < window.localStorage.length; i++) {
      current_key = window.localStorage.key(i);
      if (current_key != 'premium_tracking' && current_key != 'premium_origin' && current_key != 'icy:premium') {
        window.localStorage.removeItem(current_key);
      }
    }
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, content);
  }
}
    </script>

  function isEmbeddedInApp() {
    if (window.ivEmbedMode) return true;
    if (window.self === window.top) return false;

/*
 * Premium ad-skip flag, written by icyveins-topbar-account.js from GET /v1/billing/status.
 *
 * icy-auth's `icy_session` cookie is httpOnly and host-only to the auth domain, so neither
 * this page nor the www server can see it -- premium status is only knowable after an
 * authenticated fetch. This flag caches the last answer so the ad and analytics loaders
 * below can decide at first paint. It is a paint optimisation, not a security boundary.
 *
 * The key is shared with the Astro app (src/lib/billing/premium-flag.ts); both are served
 * from the www origin, so a signed-in reader crossing between them keeps the flag.
 */
function icyIsPremium () {
  try {
    return window.localStorage.getItem('icy:premium') === '1'
  } catch (e) {
    return false
  }
}

function writeToLocalStorage(key, content) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, content);
  } catch(e) {
    for (var i = 0; i < window.localStorage.length; i++) {
      current_key = window.localStorage.key(i);
      if (current_key != 'premium_tracking' && current_key != 'premium_origin' && current_key != 'icy:premium') {
        window.localStorage.removeItem(current_key);
      }
    }
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, content);
  }
